question: In ΔABC, AB = 7 cm, BC = 10 cm, and AC = 8 cm. If AD is the angle bisector of ∠BAC, where D is a point on BC, then DC (in cm) = ?
solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, AB = 7 cm, BC = 10 cm, and AC = 8 cm

**Concept used:**

An angle bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side into two segments that are proportional to the other two sides of the triangle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10704cbfb9480f276e7970e5208cc0cddfecb557ca49c40f2a0aa83aa30121eb.png] 

AD is the angle bisector of ∠BAC

So, AB/AC = BD/DC

⇒ 7/8 = BD/DC

⇒ 8BD = 7DC

⇒ BD = 7DC/8 .....(1)

Here, BD + DC = BC

⇒ 7DC/8 + DC = BC = 10 [∵ BD = 7DC/8]

⇒ 15DC/8 = 10

⇒ DC = 10 × (8/15) = 80/15 = 16/3

**∴ The value of DC (in cm) is 16/3**
